pricing.note: Amounts are shown for reference. Stripe checkout is always the source of truth for final pricing.

items.a1: Access is read-only and revocable at any time. Evidence is stored as minimal excerpts — we never sell your data.
items.q2: What exactly is a free investigation?
items.a2: A one-time, full scan of your connected inbox that produces a discovery feed: offers, price changes, credits, and meetings you've missed.
items.a3: Continuous monitoring, reminders, calendar actions, and chat with your inbox — the agent keeps working after the first scan.
items.a4: $5.99 per month or $49 per year. Stripe checkout is the source of truth for the final amount in your currency.
items.a5: Yes — cancel anytime from Settings → Billing. You keep Pro until the end of the billing period.
items.q6: What happens after my free investigation?
items.a6: Your discovery feed stays available. Upgrade to Pro to keep monitoring your inbox automatically.
